status: REVIEW ONLY — no playable game implementation
unit: U = provisional player-footprint planning unit; not a voxel

rooms.name: Boat Landing
rooms.layout: An irregular landing follows the riverbank. The paved arrival apron stays broad; a side dock carries the boat.
rooms.rule: No damage hazards or random enemies. The landing must identify the return point.

rooms.name: Sluice Gate
rooms.role: Introduce the first melee and ranged pairing.
rooms.pack: Suggested: warriors first; one archer in a later wave.
rooms.layout: A skewed, splayed gatehouse opens into a broad diagonal combat lane. The two low blocks sit outside the entry and exit lines.
rooms.rule: No ranged enemy on an unreachable ledge. Keep the entrance landing clear.

rooms.name: Root Court
rooms.role: First landmark encounter; reveal the route decision.
rooms.pack: Suggested: warriors and one shaman. Do not introduce all roles together.
rooms.layout: An oval court wraps a small root island. The two branches leave different curved shoulders; the perimeter remains a broad combat circuit.
rooms.rule: Open the west and east exits after combat. Show shop and elite-reward symbols before the choice.

rooms.name: Barracks
rooms.layout: The barracks fan outward from an oblique rear wall. Bunks follow the wall, while the wider eastern apron supports flanking and the court entrance.
rooms.rule: Every ranged position needs a melee approach. A clue marks the optional secret door.

rooms.name: Ember Smithy
rooms.role: Offer a predictable spending opportunity on the safer route.
rooms.layout: A rounded forge bay joins a straight counter wing. The north-to-south walking lane stays outside the work area.
rooms.rule: Optional purchases never block progression. This room is not on the risky route.

rooms.name: Hunter Cloister
rooms.pack: Suggested: archers with one rogue after an arrival pause.
rooms.layout: A wide L-shaped cloister surrounds an open garden corner. Its bend breaks a long firing line without turning the combat space into a narrow maze.
rooms.rule: No immediate surround on entry. Keep flank paths wider than the player footprint.

rooms.name: Quiet Sanctuary
rooms.role: Merge the routes and provide a one-use recovery offer.
rooms.layout: A round recovery sanctuary has four short vestibules. The fountain sits north of the crossing; the return lever remains in the south vestibule.
rooms.rule: G1 opens only when reached from a valid branch. The recovery cannot be farmed by re-entry.

rooms.name: Flooded Archive
rooms.role: Offer a clearly signposted environmental risk.
rooms.pack: Suggested: warriors and an archer; add the hazard only after the basic encounter works.
rooms.layout: A crescent gallery follows an eroded water inlet. The inward bay creates a clear shoreline; the dry western band connects both doors without a thin bridge.
rooms.rule: Bright shallow water is decorative in the first graybox. Any future damage zone needs a distinct warning.

rooms.name: Blood Vault
rooms.role: Optional harder encounter that earns the branch reward.
rooms.pack: Suggested: one enhanced warrior with shaman support. Exact tuning is untested.
rooms.layout: A faceted ritual vault has splayed corners and a broad open center. Edge monuments frame the encounter rather than divide it into corridors.
rooms.rule: Clearing this encounter unlocks both the reward in 10 and G2. The safer route must not bypass the elite.

rooms.name: Sealed Spoils
rooms.role: Pay off the elite commitment before route convergence.
rooms.layout: A small rounded apse holds the reward. Its western vestibule still meets the gated return into the sanctuary.
rooms.rule: The chest and G2 stay locked until 09 is cleared. Re-entry does not create more rewards.

rooms.name: Choir Hall
rooms.role: Final normal encounter; combine previously taught roles.
rooms.pack: Suggested: staged warrior, archer, and rogue groups.
rooms.layout: A cruciform hall combines a north apse, a broad transept, and a clear central nave. Side arms offer flanking space instead of decorative dead corridors.
rooms.rule: Do not spawn every group at once. Give a quiet interval before the boss door.

rooms.name: Spore Grotto
rooms.role: A visually distinct finale with a Chieftain encounter.
rooms.pack: Suggested: Chieftain. Add helpers only after the solo pattern is readable.
rooms.layout: An asymmetrical, multi-lobed grotto forms the finale. Recessed pools and rocky shoulders stay peripheral; a large continuous dry center supports the Chieftain encounter.
rooms.rule: Keep the center mostly empty. Show attack warnings beneath effects. The exit unlocks after the boss.

rooms.name: Hidden Cache
rooms.role: Reward exploration without making it mandatory.
rooms.layout: A tapered crypt widens beyond its concealed threshold. The shape suggests an older excavation, not another standard reward box.
rooms.rule: Use a deliberate interaction, not an assumed terrain-destruction system. Secret access cannot gate the boss.

rooms.name: Ascent
rooms.role: Finish the floor and mark the next destination.
rooms.layout: A compact dogleg stair folds around the rock face. It is an exit landmark, not an extra rectangular combat chamber.
rooms.rule: Entry requires the Chieftain clear flag. Do not put another combat encounter here.

assumptions.camera: Fixed elevated three-quarter view; north stays consistent

scale_basis: Ceiling of the largest regular-monster walking body envelope to a 0.12 m multiple. Vertices measured at existing scene scale; weapons excluded from body envelope.
